messages:
Noah Grant: Heads-up --- Reseller "Orbic Systems" (reseller ID ORB-91) asked for a temporary rate-floor reduction for their EU customers: request is 20% off list for 3 months + Net90 payment terms for initial onboarding invoices. They say local competitors are undercutting us.
Sofia Mendes: Do we have margin impact if we do 20% off for three months? Any FX exposure?
Claire Liu: Quick numbers: for projected volume this quarter, 20% off gives ~12% reduction in gross margin due to mix. FX: reseller bills in EUR so collections risk on Net90 remains.
Noah Grant: They want this as a formal channel allowance, not a one-off credit. Sales is asking for an exception so they can close a multi-customer bundle.
Marta Alvarez: Legal: if it's a channel allowance, we need a reseller amendment with explicit non-transference clause and a sunset date. Also require reseller to provide bank guarantee for Net90 in EU.
Oliver Chen: Billing side: Net90 is outside standard terms. We can support Net90 if finance signs an AR security agreement and we set a deposit or PO requirement.
BillingBot: System: created internal ticket DEAL-4056 for reseller terms change.
Sofia Mendes: Finance preference: can we split concession? 10% off (channel allowance) + accelerate collections via escrow/PO for Net90. That reduces margin hit to ~6%.
Noah Grant: Sales says Orbic will only do 20% or walk; they have multiple small customers ready.
Claire Liu: Risk ops: If we agree Net90, flag as higher DSO and escalate to CFO for sign-off. Also set a cap on total discounted ARR credited to the reseller (e.g., cap at 150k EUR).
Marta Alvarez: Draft clause: "Reseller Discount: Redwood Inference grants Reseller a temporary channel allowance of 10% off list prices for eligible customer orders executed between DATE_A and DATE_B. Any extension or increase in discount must be approved in writing by Redwood's Finance leadership. Payment terms remain Net30 unless a secured PO/escrow is provided."
Noah Grant: That is likely a dealbreaker. Can we counter with 15% + secured PO + capped volume?
Sofia Mendes: I'll run quick model: 15% + PO reduces margin hit to ~8% and mitigates credit risk substantially. I can support that if CFO approves.
Oliver Chen: Billing: if PO or escrow provided, we'll set invoice hold release on fund confirmation. Net90 only upon fund-backed PO.
BillingBot: Note: DEAL-4056 pending CFO review.
Marta Alvarez: Legal approves 15% + secured PO + 90-day sunset and explicit non-precedent language. Will draft amendment.
Noah Grant: Great. @Sofia Mendes can you get CFO approval? I'll tell Orbic we can do 15% if they upload secured PO within 7 days and cap is 150k EUR.
Sofia Mendes: Looping in CFO via Deal Desk. Sent note to finance-approvals@redwood.com with the model and risk appendix.
Oliver Chen: Created billing instruction BILL-1149 to hold until PO verified.
BillingBot: CFO Response: Approved conditionally  (recorded in DEAL-4056).
Noah Grant: Thanks team. Final terms to present: 15% channel allowance for 90 days, requires secured PO/escrow to enable Net90, cap 150k EUR, non-precedential. I'll update Orbic and attach draft amendment.
Marta Alvarez: Filing amendment template under /reseller-amendments/ORB-91.
Sofia Mendes: Marking as approved for billing execution once PO verifies.
Noah Grant: Closing thread unless resale team pushes back.
